propositions: BindingStore identity transition rules (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID rekey) need extraction into a dedicated BindingLifecycle policy owner with table-driven tests covering valid, missing, corrupt, duplicate, and stale forward/reverse combinations
bind_confirm must implement last-writer-wins on forward entry, popping exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep, no ambiguity detection, and no abort
Stale reverse entries may be removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind with sweep, numeric-ID rekey, and _retire transitions
Numeric-ID rekey must swap both indexes (old and new reverse keys) atomically, reset absence counter, and preserve jira_id immutably instead of retiring the binding

note_absent_or_rekey seam delegates the rekey mutation (step 4: different current key path) to BindingLifecycle.rekey while the facade retains coordination, guard, and no-client/no-id fallthrough to note_absent

Every valid transition must leave at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry, verified by reloading both indexes from disk and asserting each reverse key's local_id points back to the same jira_key
